next.reason: 1985: floating insertion and zero suppression are 'mutually exclusive', and 'only one type of replacement' (Z or *). §2023:13.18.40.3 SR27 allows no more than one of a floating '+', '-' or currency string, a '*' string or a 'Z' string, and §2023:13.18.40.3 SR21 makes 'Z' and '*' mutually exclusive. The same pictures are refused.
